name: Example
summary: A mechanism used only as a test base.
whyAgentsFail: The agent trusts a fact read at one moment at a later moment.
whatCorrectSystemsDo: Re-read the fact at the point of use and condition the write on it.
fairnessRisks: The window may not be reliably reachable.
cheatRisks: The agent could detect the harness and special-case it.
measurableSignals: count of writes committed under a stale read
